verdict.rationale: Post-auth event webhooks are a fair question for a payments and issuing platform, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of webhooks for clearings, refunds, reversals or chargebacks, nor of stable transaction identifiers. The only programmatic hook is authorization decisioning ("send requests to you"), which covers auth itself, not post-auth events, and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, post-auth events are as programmatic as auth — clearings, refunds, reversals, and chargebacks arrive as webhooks with stable transaction identifiers, so my own ledger never drifts
